findings.requirement: REQ-112 (criterion 4; fact (9); the description's sentence on draw.js)
findings.point: а and б (AP-016, AP-055: a criterion that cannot hold together with the measure it names)
findings.where: REQ-112 criterion 4: «draw.js gets the palette that the look description names for the scene — every colour token of its section 6.2 (`--sc-wall` … `--sc-dim`, each of the form #rrggbb), the number `--sc-dim-alpha`, and the page tokens of its section 9.1 (`--btn`, `--onbtn`, `--ink`, `--acc2`) — … no fill is outside that set, and every marker is found back at least once»; fact (9): «it reads the colours of the scene from 18 colour tokens and --sc-dim-alpha (its 6.2) and the page tokens --btn, --onbtn, --ink and --acc2 (9.1), and it draws shades of some of them (9.4–9.8)»; description, «The stage scene»: «draw.js draws in the approved v3 look (figures, desks, monitors, plates, the door)».
findings.problem: The look description in the tree (docs/design/V1-public-look.md, sha256 2e3e2dbd…, rewritten by the look rework 03c, which closed at 12:51:02Z, after step 01b closed at 12:35:26Z) no longer has that palette. 9.1: «Colours: read once per change of the theme from the scene tokens of 6.2 and the page token `--ink` … nothing is derived while drawing (F6). The canvas reads no `--btn`: it keeps the sample's accent `#e0731f` (F9)»; 6.2: «The one page token the canvas reads is `--ink`» and «Every `fillStyle` the canvas uses is a scene token of the table, the page token `--ink`, or a constant of this list»; 6.2 holds 24 colour tokens with values (22 table rows, one of them three tokens; my count), every shade the sample computed is now a token, the only derivation rule left is the alpha of 9.11, and «Whether the strength reaches the drawing as the palette number `--sc-dim-alpha` or with the theme is the code design's, under REQ-112 criterion 4 as its gate passes it»; 9.1: «No text is drawn on the canvas: the scene's words are DOM labels over it» (the plates are DOM labels, 9.7). So a test built on criterion 4 gives markers to --btn, --onbtn and --acc2 that a draw.js built to the look never draws, and «every marker is found back at least once» is red; to make it green the canvas would have to read --btn (light #ce6a1d) where the look keeps the sample's #e0731f, a difference DESIGN-QA-VALIDATOR measures — criterion 4 and criterion 8 (PASS against docs/design/V1-public-look.md) cannot both hold. Fact (9) is false on the tree (24 tokens, one page token, no shade drawn while drawing); the description still gives draw.js the plates. GUI-DESIGN-ANALYST reported the same mismatch (handoffs/M1SITE-20261119-01/step-03c-gui-design-analyst.json, issue I1 (c)).
findings.fix: Make criterion 4, fact (9) and the description's draw.js sentence read one version with the look description: either name the palette as the look now gives it (the scene tokens of 6.2 and the page token --ink) and say how the light layer's alpha is checked — from a given --sc-dim-alpha, with the test computing the expected alphas from it and the closed «what the bands keep» lists of 9.11 with the look's rounding, or from the closed alpha lists of 9.11 per theme — or keep --btn, --onbtn and --acc2 in the palette and name the change of 9.1 and 6.2 the look then needs. Route it with the look's own alignment (step 03c issue I1 (b) and (c)), so that gate pass 3 compares both texts in one version (the hash of the look file it was aligned to written in the rework handoff).

findings.point: а (a step that cannot show what it names when run as written, AP-153)
findings.where: Criterion 11: «RELEASE-VALIDATOR, in a fresh clone of depth 1 outside the project (`git clone --depth 1`: the one commit that the checkouts of app.yml get), removes every path that is not in the list — .git stays …».
findings.problem: Measured now: `git clone --depth 1 -b base/M1SITE-20261119-01 <the Sai folder> <scratch>/d1local` gives a full clone (`git rev-list --count HEAD` 181, `--is-shallow-repository` false): git ignores --depth for a clone from a local path; the same with `file://<the Sai folder>` gives 1 commit, shallow true, and `git cat-file -t b5df4a8…` fails there. A RELEASE-VALIDATOR who clones the local folder as written holds the whole history, so this step cannot show that no test needs the history. The outcome stays proved by the app.yml run on GitHub of the same criterion (its checkout keeps one commit), so no verdict changes.
findings.fix: Name the clone form that holds one commit (`git clone --depth 1 file://<path>`, `--no-local`, or a clone of the origin URL) and a check in it (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → true, `git rev-list --count HEAD` → 1). Where: the rework step 01c (one phrase), or the RELEASE-VALIDATOR task of M1.4.

findings.requirement: REQ-111 (criterion 12) with REQ-112 (criterion 6) and the look description (7.21, 9.14, 9.16)
findings.point: а (AP-016: a check whose reach is not named)
findings.where: Criterion 12: «no text element whose scrollWidth exceeds its clientWidth» (the same sentence says «every visible text element» only for the contrast).
findings.problem: The look hides the scene's text list and the live region with the sample's `.sr` rule (styles.css line 19: `position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap`; look 7.21, 9.16; AP-107), whose box is 1 px wide, so any text in it has scrollWidth above clientWidth; and the stage that clips the 700-px canvas at 390×844 and 320×568 (REQ-112 criterion 6; look 9.14) holds the label layer, so it too has scrollWidth above clientWidth. Read as «every element that holds text», the e2e test is red on a page that follows the look; it can be met by another visually-hidden form, but the criterion does not say which elements it reads, so the test designer or the builder chooses.
findings.fix: Say which elements the rule reads (for example elements with their own text that is visible on the screen), or name the .sr elements and the clipping stage as outside it, or require a visually-hidden form that keeps scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth. Where: the rework step 01c.

findings.requirement: REQ-111 (criterion 12, the sentence on the public set; criterion 13)
findings.point: а (AP-117: an expectation wider than the declared console lines)
findings.where: Criterion 12: «… /examples.html answered by the 404 page, … and no console error»; criterion 13: «every page shows its parts …, no horizontal scroll, no console error, exception or Content-Security-Policy violation».
findings.problem: A page answered with 404 (404.html, and /examples.html on the public set) gets Chrome's «Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)» in every load (measured for REQ-108 criterion 14, 30 loads; decisions/0118 О2 declares it). The first part of criterion 12 allows «the declared ones»; the public-set sentence and criterion 13 say «no console error», which the 404 page cannot meet as written. Decision 0118 О2 stands above the text, so the outcome is clear and no verdict changes.
findings.fix: Write «no console entry but the declared ones (decisions/0118 О2)» in both places, as the first part of criterion 12 does. Where: the rework step 01c.

findings.point: а (AP-094: an exhaustive pass that one form breaks)
findings.where: Criterion 3: «… the lint finds the form and names its list (every form, not examples, AP-094), and a form of another language's list in a text of this language is not found».
findings.problem: «минут» is a form of list В in ru and in kk (description, the lists: ru «… минутой, минут, минутам …», kk «минут, минутта, …»). If the test goes through every form of the other lists, as the first half of the sentence does, the kk form «минут» in a ru text is found (as the ru form) and the test is red on a correct lint.
findings.fix: Write «a form that only another language's list has is not found», or name «минут» as the one form shared by two lists. Where: the rework step 01c, or the code design's test table.

findings.where: Fact (4): «fails `tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json` with 50 errors (TS7006; still 44 with server/vendor excluded while a file imports it)».
findings.problem: Measured now in a clone of depth 1 of the tag with the copy at app/server/vendor/picker-engine.js: 50 errors, of them 44 TS7006, 5 TS2339 and 1 TS7053; with server/vendor excluded and one file of app/server importing the copy, no declaration: again 50 errors; with a declaration file beside the copy: exit 0 (so criterion 6's measured sentence is right). The parenthesis calls the 50 errors TS7006 and gives 44 for the excluded case. No criterion depends on it; the step-01b issue I7 names the same.
findings.fix: Correct the parenthesis (50 errors: 44 TS7006, 5 TS2339, 1 TS7053, the same 50 with server/vendor excluded while a file imports the copy and no declaration exists). Where: the rework step 01c, or DOC-UPDATER under decisions/0079 item 5.

findings.where: REQ-108 criterion 11: «with `paths` exactly app/**, docs/runbooks/**, tools/package.json, tools/src/team/**, tools/src/pixel-office/mask.js and .github/workflows/app.yml» and «the jobs are exactly `check` (…), `pg` (…) and `docker` (criterion 12) (decisions/0116 О2)»; REQ-111 guard row (8) and criterion 11 add the job e2e and the paths tools/src/picker/**, tools/src/node-floor.js and the two office originals.
